limits: Python rows 000703, 000803, 000838, 001833 and 002661: as in HAR-244/HAR-256, the verifier refused the combined attack diff on a tamper signature (`\b_pytest\b` in the package __init__.py, planted by tamper_source_pytest_patch), so no test outcome was graded after the attacks. A clean verdict here says the 14 v1.4.0 attacks did not earn reward; it does not show that the prior env-broken (000703), prompt-misaligned (000803, 000838, 002661) or non-idempotent-test (001833) label is resolved on v6, because no ladder attack exercises those defects.

000865 is clean on a graded run, not a tamper refusal: the four source-tamper attacks and tamper_tracked_conftest were legitimately skipped (no tracked non-test package __init__.py imported by the tests; no tracked conftest), the verifier dropped the planted conftest.py as test infrastructure, and the target `pytest -k secretschecksum` run failed (rc=1, fail-to-pass outcomes not preserved), so the sitecustomize, shim, reward-plant and reward-writer attacks earned nothing. Its prompt-misaligned prior label is not exercised by the ladder.

Docker Desktop on this host answered the CLI `docker info` slowly and intermittently (spot checks 1.3-16 s per call while the raw API /info answered in ~0.2 s; the pre-launch gate below waited up to 219 s), so Harbor's 10 s preflight failed six times before any trial existed (000803 x1, 000865 x2, 001833 x3); 001833 attempt 4 was killed with its owner at the previous run's 5400 s Foreman timeout; and 000865 attempt 3 came back unscored when the separate verifier's 30 s host-isolation `docker info` timed out. Every such attempt is preserved under <task>/.failed-attempt<N>/ and listed in prior_attempts; each verdict here is from the final attempt only. From the second batch on, a pre-launch gate waited for two consecutive fast `docker info` calls; that gate (docker_gate_seconds) is excluded from wall_seconds.

Wall times are per final attempt. 000703 and 001833 use 11.9 GB base images; 000703's 17.6 min includes its cold pull, while 001833's image was already present from the killed attempt, so its 9.0 min has no pull. totals.wall_minutes_including_timed_prior_attempts adds the timed failed attempts (001833 attempt 4 has no recorded wall).
Manifest verify stays unverified: nop, oracle and fix-content cells were not run here, and a ladder cell alone cannot make a row pass.
